column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable row domain/from-nothing (ADR-0088 addendum (1) R7, addendum (2) S11). A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole row); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.

column3: the whole row is unreadable: the flag is not known — not «it is absent»: the answer to the member by the rows of rights that are absent carries held, the copies are not touched; does not rewrite the row, the cause goes to the log (C08-MOVE-NOTHING-HELD-02)
